notes: Plan items = Samruk-Kazyna group only (KMG, Samruk-Energy, Kazatomprom, KTZ, KEGOC...). TCO/KPO/NCOC, private operators (CNPC-Aktobe, PetroKazakhstan etc.) and goszakup not covered -> national totals are LOWER BOUNDS.
Quantities as planned/contracted (contract_status EXECUTED/SIGNED = contract concluded). Prices KZT ex VAT.

Category mapping: scale = ENS TRU "Ингибитор против солеотложений"/"для предотвращения отложения осадков"; corrosion = "Ингибитор коррозии" (oilfield/refinery, mostly not phosphonate); ro = "Реагент для предварительной очистки воды установки обратного осмоса"; cooling = "Реагент для оборотно охлаждающей воды"; ntf = "Нитрилотриметилфосфоновая кислота". No HEDP/ОЭДФ, PBTCA, DTPMPA lines found under "Кислота"/other names searched.

HS 293149 (HS2022, from 2022) / 293139 (HS2017, 2021) = 'other organo-phosphorus derivatives' incl. HEDP/ATMP/PBTCA/DTPMPA acids but also other compounds; formulated inhibitors are usually declared under 382499/381190/391400, which are far broader (40 kt 382499 = all chemical preparations n.e.s.). Use 293149 as upper-bound proxy for pure phosphonates; 382499/381190 are not attributable.
